cobbleeffort.fossil.mycolith.name: Spire Fossil
cobbleeffort.fossil.petroleodd.name: Ancient Tar
cobbleeffort.species.amalgum.desc: Three Cavitot that had their cavities filled and fused into one. The metal in their fillings makes it tough to crack, but all three of its faces still frown. It gnaws on iron ore to keep its caps shiny.
cobbleeffort.species.amalgum.name: Amalgum
cobbleeffort.species.assoulsect.desc: When thousands of Bug Pokémon perished, a fungus took root in what was left of them and wove their souls into one mind. Their old heads and blades still twitch in its fog; any Bug Pokémon that challenges it is pulled into the hive and turns on its own allies.
cobbleeffort.species.assoulsect.name: Assoulsect
cobbleeffort.species.blanketula.desc: When it outgrows its seed it picks out a big leaf and never lets go of it again. It sleeps wrapped up in it, hides under it when anything startles it, and grows very upset if the leaf is taken away.
cobbleeffort.species.blanketula.name: Blanketula
cobbleeffort.species.capybrute.desc: It lounges by rivers as calmly as a boulder and lets other Pokémon nap on its back, but it digs burrows through solid rock with those claws. Rile it and it charges with its head down, shrugging off blows that would flatten a house.
cobbleeffort.species.capybrute.name: Capybrute
cobbleeffort.species.cardling.desc: It sings sweetly from the branches at dawn, and its song is said to bring good luck to anyone who hears it first thing in the morning. It is tiny, round and fearless.
cobbleeffort.species.cardling.name: Cardling
cobbleeffort.species.cavitot.desc: It started out as a baby tooth that was never brushed. The cavity in its crown aches all the time, which is why it always looks so grumpy. It can't resist sweets, even though they make the ache worse.
cobbleeffort.species.cavitot.name: Cavitot
cobbleeffort.species.cinderoon.desc: Once it has eaten enough coal, it wraps its soft body in a cocoon of cinders. The ash is thin enough to see the Coalarva curled up inside, and it can burn some of it away to hurl a blast of fire at anything that disturbs it.
cobbleeffort.species.cinderoon.name: Cinderoon
cobbleeffort.species.coalarva.desc: It lives in caves deep underground where coal seams run thick, and it eats nothing but coal. A special organ in its abdomen turns the minerals it swallows into heat, which is why its tail end always glows.
cobbleeffort.species.coalarva.name: Coalarva
cobbleeffort.species.cutlassfly.desc: Its wings are blades sharp enough to slice falling leaves in two. It hovers perfectly still over rivers, then darts away faster than the eye can follow, leaving cut reeds behind it.
cobbleeffort.species.cutlassfly.name: Cutlassfly
cobbleeffort.species.elastigoose.desc: Its neck stretches like rubber, letting it snatch food from the riverbed or honk right in a foe's face from far away. Its honk is so loud it can be heard three valleys over.
cobbleeffort.species.elastigoose.name: Elastigoose
cobbleeffort.species.forgnash.desc: Once it stands on two legs, the fire inside it bursts out through its back. It hammers metal ore with its claws to sharpen them, and the sparks fly like a forge.
cobbleeffort.species.forgnash.name: Forgnash
cobbleeffort.species.gatterfly.desc: Its arms have become guns that spray stingers so fast and so hot they glow, and its wings are made of fire. Besides fighting with them, it melts stone with its flames to build its nest.
cobbleeffort.species.gatterfly.name: Gatterfly
cobbleeffort.species.gigantler.desc: The antlers on its head grow back bigger every year, and an old bull's three crowns can span wider than a cabin. Packs of predators turn back the moment it lowers its head, and travellers in the northern woods take a glimpse of one as a sign of good fortune.
cobbleeffort.species.gigantler.name: Gigantler
cobbleeffort.species.jerbolt.desc: It floats over desert dunes at night with its tail curled round it in a ring. Anything that stares at the turning ring for long falls into a daze, and Jerbolt hops off with its food.
cobbleeffort.species.jerbolt.name: Jerbolt
cobbleeffort.species.jormbuoy.desc: It bobs along on cold seas under a hull of old ship's timbers, shields lined up along its sides. Sailors used to tie their boats to it, mistaking it for a buoy, until it swam away with them.
cobbleeffort.species.jormbuoy.name: Jormbuoy
cobbleeffort.species.jorminous.desc: The ghost of a sunken raiding ship that has become a great sea serpent. When it rises out of the fog with its shields gleaming and its oars beating, whole fleets turn back to shore.
cobbleeffort.species.jorminous.name: Jorminous
cobbleeffort.species.magmalodon.desc: Its body burns hotter than a smelter, and the smoke pouring off its head hangs down its back like dreadlocks. A single bite from its huge jaws can tear through a steel girder.
cobbleeffort.species.magmalodon.name: Magmalodon
cobbleeffort.species.mantasma.desc: A Mawntis that hunted on a moonless night and came back as something else. It towers over the trees, its grin glows in the dark, and its ghostly scythes cut through anything without ever missing. Even so, it still clasps its forelegs together the way it did as a Prayling.
cobbleeffort.species.mantasma.name: Mantasma
cobbleeffort.species.mawntis.desc: Its head has split into a maw full of fangs, and a second set of legs lets it run down prey in the undergrowth. It still has no eyes, but its scythes find their mark every time.
cobbleeffort.species.mawntis.name: Mawntis
cobbleeffort.species.mesmerboa.desc: Its tail is so long it never touches the ground: it hangs round Mesmerboa in a great ring that crackles with electricity. Spun fast, the ring can put a whole herd of Pokémon to sleep at once.
cobbleeffort.species.mesmerboa.name: Mesmerboa
cobbleeffort.species.mousense.desc: Its eyes stay shut from the day it hatches. It feels its way about with its long whiskers, which can pick up the flutter of a moth's wings across a meadow, so sneaking up on it is near impossible.
cobbleeffort.species.mousense.name: Mousense
cobbleeffort.species.mumpillar.desc: It wraps itself in strips of silk soaked in river water and never takes them off. Old tales say anyone who unwraps one is cursed, and that it cannot be finished off: struck down, it rises again angrier than before.
cobbleeffort.species.mumpillar.name: Mumpillar
cobbleeffort.species.mycolith.desc: Revived from the Spire Fossil. Over 400 million years ago, fields of Mycolith dominated the barren land before true trees ever took root. Researchers originally mistook its fossilized remains for ancient timber.
cobbleeffort.species.mycolith.name: Mycolith
cobbleeffort.species.orthodread.desc: Eight teeth held together by braces it can never take off. It scuttles through dark caves on its steel legs and its bite can crunch through iron. The braces put it in a foul mood, and it takes that out on anyone it meets.
cobbleeffort.species.orthodread.name: Orthodread
cobbleeffort.species.petroleodd.desc: A pile of tar from the bottom of an ancient tar pit, brought back to life with the bones of old Pokémon still inside it. It is sleepy and slow, and anything that touches it comes away stuck.
cobbleeffort.species.petroleodd.name: Petroleodd
cobbleeffort.species.petroleossil.desc: Holding a King's Rock, Petroleodd swallows tar and sludge until it becomes a mountain of it, with the fossil skull of an ancient tyrant floating up through the middle. It roars through its jaws.
cobbleeffort.species.petroleossil.name: Petroleossil
cobbleeffort.species.pharantis.desc: It rules the river valleys with a crook of gold at the end of each scythe, and moves so fast its foes never see it strike. Those who think they have defeated it soon learn about the pharaoh's curse.
cobbleeffort.species.pharantis.name: Pharantis
cobbleeffort.species.pipider.desc: One of the smallest Pokémon there is: it fits on a fingertip. It hides under a seed it found and carries it everywhere like a shell, and when it is frightened it tucks its legs in and pretends to be an ordinary seed.
cobbleeffort.species.pipider.name: Pipider
cobbleeffort.species.prayling.desc: It is born without eyes, yet it never misses. It feels the faintest stir of air through its leafy feelers and knows exactly where its prey is, then holds its little forelegs together and waits.
cobbleeffort.species.prayling.name: Prayling
cobbleeffort.species.raddent.desc: It plants itself in a vegetable patch and pretends to be a radish until the farmer goes home, then nibbles everything in sight. Pull on its leaves and it squeaks and bolts.
cobbleeffort.species.raddent.name: Raddent
cobbleeffort.species.rattlebunch.desc: Several Raddent whose leaves grew tangled together in the same patch, tied fast with a farmer's twine. They argue constantly about which way to run, but when they agree, nothing can catch them.
cobbleeffort.species.rattlebunch.name: Rattlebunch
cobbleeffort.species.rubraptor.desc: A proud hawk that guards its territory from the treetops. Its red wings flash like a warning as it dives, yet it is gentle with Pokémon smaller than itself and shares its catch with them.
cobbleeffort.species.rubraptor.name: Rubraptor
cobbleeffort.species.sarcoon.desc: Its silk hardens into a coffin painted like a pharaoh's. It lies still for weeks, but anything foolish enough to pry at the lid wakes the curse, and the case's eyes light up.
cobbleeffort.species.sarcoon.name: Sarcoon
cobbleeffort.species.sensarat.desc: It sweeps its long whiskers through the dark like feelers and senses an attack before it comes, striking first. It never opens its eyes; those who have seen them say they are as bright as stars.
cobbleeffort.species.sensarat.name: Sensarat
cobbleeffort.species.sharkindle.desc: It swims through the ground near lava as easily as a shark through water, its orange fins glowing where they cut through the hot rock. Its bite can dent iron.
cobbleeffort.species.sharkindle.name: Sharkindle
cobbleeffort.species.sheathalis.desc: Its cocoon hardens into something like a block of wood with knife handles sticking out of it. The blades inside are its new wings growing, and it peeks out of the front to keep watch.
cobbleeffort.species.sheathalis.name: Sheathalis
cobbleeffort.species.shivnymph.desc: It hatches near water with a tiny blade already at the end of its tail. It keeps the edge sharp by scraping it on river stones, and flicks it at anything that comes too close.
cobbleeffort.species.shivnymph.name: Shivnymph
cobbleeffort.species.squeakling.desc: It bobs along on rivers and ponds without a care, and squeaks whenever it is squeezed. Its body is light and springy, so it never sinks, however rough the water.
cobbleeffort.species.squeakling.name: Squeakling
cobbleeffort.species.tanhyll.desc: It stands up on its hind legs to tear open Bug Pokémon nests with its huge claws, then slurps up everything inside with its long hooked tongue. Bug Pokémon flee at its very scent.
cobbleeffort.species.tanhyll.name: Tanhyll
cobbleeffort.species.taxitower.desc: Towering over ancient swamps, Taxitower absorbed nutrients from the surrounding soil through miles of underground threads. When threatened, it releases blinding clouds of prehistoric spores that haven't been breathed in eons.
cobbleeffort.species.taxitower.name: Taxitower
cobbleeffort.species.tikilla.desc: Its fists have grown as big as tiki masks, and it carves faces into them to look fiercer. It leads its troop with thundering kicks and shakes its great white mane to warn rivals away.
cobbleeffort.species.tikilla.name: Tikilla
cobbleeffort.species.tikimp.desc: It paints its face like a skull to scare off bigger Pokémon, then kickboxes anything that isn't scared. It practises its kicks on bamboo all day long and never seems to tire.
cobbleeffort.species.tikimp.name: Tikimp
cobbleeffort.species.typeerror.desc: A failed experiment built to be faster and deadlier than any other. The mask clamped over its head keeps its corrupted power in check. Its type cannot be read: every attack hits it the same, except the most ordinary ones.
cobbleeffort.species.typeerror.name: Type: Error
cobblemon.ability.blindsight.desc: The Pokémon is blind, yet it senses everything around it: every move it uses hits, whatever its accuracy, and even targets that are flying, underground or underwater.
cobblemon.ability.hivemind.desc: Thousands of fallen Bug Pokémon live on in it, bound by a fungus: a Bug-type foe's moves can never harm it. The hive seizes them, and the attack strikes the foe's own side instead.
cobblemon.ability.insectivore.desc: The Pokémon was made to hunt Bug Pokémon: all of its attacks are extremely super effective (4x) on Bug types, whatever their type, and nothing about them makes a Bug type immune.
cobblemon.ability.paleomycelium.desc: An ancient fungus long mistaken for a plant: its Grass-type moves get the same-type bonus, and it is immune to Leech Seed and to powder and spore moves.
cobblemon.ability.pharaohscurse.desc: Once per battle, a hit that would knock the Pokémon out doesn't: it rises again at half its HP and its Attack and Sp. Atk sharply rise.
cobblemon.ability.systemerror.desc: The Pokémon's type is Error: every move hits it for neutral damage except Normal-type moves, which are super effective. Its own Normal-type moves hit everything for neutral damage, ghosts included, and are super effective on Normal types.
cobblemon.battle.damage.devoniandrift: %1$s is weighed down by the ancient spores!
cobblemon.battle.damage.hivemind: %1$s was struck by its own side's attack!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.ally.devoniandr: The ancient spores around your team settled!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.opponent.devoni: The ancient spores around the opposing team settled!
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.ally.devonian: Ancient spores drifted down around your team!
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.opponent.devo: Ancient spores drifted down around the opposing team!
cobblemon.move.devoniandrift.desc: Scatters heavy, ancient spores over the opposing side for five turns. At the end of each turn they hurt every grounded opponent that isn't Poison or Steel type and weigh it down, lowering its Speed.
cobblemon.move.machinegunstinger.desc: Spins up its Gatling arms and sprays the target with red-hot stingers two to five times in a row. Each stinger may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.species.brutebonnet-mega.desc: Its stalk has grown into a colossal trunk like the giant fungi of ancient times, taller than the trees around it. Moss hangs from its cap, and its fists can fell a forest.
cobblemon.species.fluttermane-mega.desc: Its feathery mane spreads like great wings and its beads glow with eerie light. Its cries are said to drive whole villages from their homes.
cobblemon.species.gougingfire-mega.desc: Its golden mane flares into a crown of flame. The ground smoulders under its hooves.
cobblemon.species.greattusk-mega.desc: Its tusks have grown into great curling arcs and its hide into stone-hard plates. It rolls through mountains as if they were sand.
cobblemon.species.ironboulder-mega.desc: Its horn-blade glows white-hot and its armour has grown into a moving fortress.
cobblemon.species.ironbundle-mega.desc: Its sack has become a huge cannon of ice. It glides through blizzards it makes itself.
cobblemon.species.ironcrown-mega.desc: Its crest-blades have spread into a crown of floating swords that guard it on every side.
cobblemon.species.ironhands-mega.desc: Its hands have grown into colossal pistons. One punch can flatten a building.
cobblemon.species.ironjugulis-mega.desc: Its three heads glow with targeting lights and its wings have turned to blades.
cobblemon.species.ironleaves-mega.desc: Its blade-horns have grown into a crest of glowing swords that can cut through steel.
cobblemon.species.ironmoth-mega.desc: Its wing panels have spread into a blazing halo that scorches the air around it.
cobblemon.species.ironthorns-mega.desc: Its armour has thickened into a fortress of spikes humming with electricity.
cobblemon.species.irontreads-mega.desc: Its treads have widened into great glowing wheels. It speeds across the land like a runaway train.
cobblemon.species.ironvaliant-mega.desc: Its blades have lengthened into a flowing cape of light. It fights as gracefully as it dances.
cobblemon.species.koraidon-mega.desc: Its wing-feathers have unfurled into a blazing crown. The sun is said to burn hotter wherever it spreads them.
cobblemon.species.miraidon-mega.desc: Its body-fins have flared into wings of pure light. It races through the sky faster than lightning.
cobblemon.species.ragingbolt-mega.desc: Its storm-cloud mane crackles constantly. Lightning is said to answer its roar.
cobblemon.species.roaringmoon-mega.desc: Its wings have joined into a great crescent like a blood-red moon. Old tales say it rose on nights when the moon turned red.
cobblemon.species.sandyshocks-mega.desc: Its magnets have grown into great arches crackling with sand. It drags whole sandstorms behind it.
cobblemon.species.screamtail-mega.desc: Its fluffy mane bristles and its tail has grown long enough to coil round its foes. Its scream can shatter boulders.
cobblemon.species.slitherwing-mega.desc: Its six wings blaze like a wildfire. It crawls through the forest on its many legs, scorching all it touches.
cobblemon.species.walkingwake-mega.desc: Its mane streams like burning water. Old stories say rain followed wherever it walked.
